provider: HKU Faculty of Engineering BEng(CE/EE/ElecE) Syllabus
note: The official syllabus applies to 2025-26 entrants and thereafter, so it covers the 2026 cohort. The aggregate 6987 admission entry is represented as three isolated selectable Majors. Each list contains its own fixed Engineering Core, Discipline Core, complete published A-E/I/J Discipline Elective universe, optional Focus memberships, compulsory internship and capstone. The Focus tables also name seven courses outside A-E/I/J; their credits are cross-checked against current official HKU CDS course pages or the official BEng(ME) syllabus before inclusion. The open general Elective category, Common Core, unnamed second AILT course, approved MSc choices and other non-credit University requirements are excluded. A course appearing in an official subject group but already compulsory for a Major is kept only as Core for that Major and is not double-counted as an elective.

supplements.evidenceNote: The official 2025-26 Computer Engineering syllabus applies to students admitted in 2025-26 and thereafter and publishes the complete 240-credit category structure, fixed core, Discipline Elective groups, optional Focuses, internship and capstone. Focus-only COMP/FITE credits are cross-checked against the official 2025-26 School of Computing and Data Science course pages; MECH3430 and MECH3431 credits are cross-checked against the official BEng(ME) 2025-26 syllabus. Open general Electives, Common Core, the unnamed second AILT course, approved MSc choices and non-credit University requirements are excluded rather than fabricated.
